name: Michiaki
source:
A second-year student at High School A, located near Shibuya. A classmate of Memory's. He's the tallest person in school, so he stands out anywhere he goes. He's outgoing. cheerful, and full of curiosity. Because of his honesty and open nature, he's bad at lying, and he can't keep a secret for long.

He has a variety of hobbies including video games, manga, sports, and watching movies. Recently he's gotten into digging up obscure B-rated movies at rental video shops. He and Cult are good friends and constantly together. But ever since Cult started talking to Memory, he's had this feeling that something terrible will happen, so he drops by Cult's job every day to keep an eye on him. He might seem like a stalker, but he does it out of sincere concern.
[Edited from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2943040]Steam[/url]]
